environment: Preparation environment, Python 3.12.14; not Mac or cloud execution

dataset.rights: FiveThirtyEight, Historical NBA Elo, CC BY 4.0; original game information: Basketball-Reference. Converted to team totals only; aggregate entries are not players.

comparison.method: Online logistic regression; earlier dates only

interpretation: The logistic model has lower Brier error than the historical-rate baseline but higher error than the constant 50% baseline on the same 72 games. This single sample does not establish future predictive accuracy.
